name: io.github.mhbxyz/gimp-mcp
title: GIMP
description: Inspect and edit images in a running GIMP 3.2+ (layers, text, filters, files) from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: GIMP_MCP_SOCKET
environmentVariables.description: Bridge socket of the GIMP to drive (default: found automatically). The GIMP plug-in must be installed once with `uvx gimp-mcp setup`.
